title: PAL-V joins AeroNL to strengthen development of the Dutch aviation sector
summary: AeroNL is the Dutch industry association representing the aviation and aerospace sector.
body_markdown:
PAL-V has joined AeroNL, the Dutch industry association representing the aviation and aerospace sector.


Through this membership, PAL-V further strengthens its position within the Dutch aviation ecosystem and expands opportunities for collaboration with industry partners, knowledge institutions, and government organizations.


Joining AeroNL provides PAL-V with access to a strong national and international network focused on knowledge exchange, policy development, certification, innovation, and the future of sustainable aviation.


“Collaboration between innovative companies, policymakers, and knowledge institutions is essential to addressing tomorrow’s mobility challenges,” said Robert Dingemanse, CEO at PAL-V.


“By joining AeroNL, we are strengthening our connection to the Dutch aviation ecosystem and creating new opportunities to contribute to the future of aviation and FlyDrive mobility. We look forward to working alongside industry partners to help shape this emerging market.”


AeroNL represents a broad network of organizations active in aviation and aerospace, supporting the sector through industry representation, policy engagement, international trade missions, and ecosystem development.


As Advanced Air Mobility continues to gain momentum, PAL-V sees a strong opportunity to work together with AeroNL’s network to help advance FlyDrive solutions: a new mobility category that integrates road and air mobility into a single platform, enabling professionals to reach more locations, faster and more effectively.


“We are delighted to welcome PAL-V to AeroNL,” said Paul Eijssen, managing director of AeroNL.


“Organizations such as PAL-V show how broad the Dutch aerospace and aviation sector is, and how it is working on the mobility challenges of tomorrow. It is also encouraging that, with PAL-V, the Netherlands could once again have its own OEM. We look forward to working together and to further strengthening the Dutch aerospace ecosystem.”


By joining AeroNL, PAL-V reinforces its ambition to play a leading role in the continued development of the Dutch aviation sector while advancing the global adoption of FlyDrive mobility.


With nearly two decades of development experience and a decade-long lead in certification and regulatory know-how, PAL-V continues to build the foundations for the future of FlyDrive mobility.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by PAL-V.*
